name: Crowns
overview: Scripture portrays crowns as symbols of glory, honor, and divine reward. The Lord Himself is described as a crown of glory to His people (Isaiah 28:5; 62:3), emphasizing His beauty and authority. Believers are promised the crown of life as a reward for enduring temptation and remaining faithful even unto death (James 1:12; Revelation 2:10), highlighting the eternal blessing given to those who love God. Additionally, the call to guard one's crown (Revelation 3:11) underscores the responsibility to remain steadfast in faith.
